final_claim: For all a,q≥1,b≥a+2, the positive Buchweitz indices of A=[0,a]∪[b,b+q] are an integer interval and beta(n) has the exact all-index adjacent-gap formula; 2 is never positive.
limitations: The theorem requires exactly two disjoint integer blocks each with at least two elements; does not classify arbitrary gapsets or prove unimodality.
